templates.name: literature_depth_rule
templates.rationale: Fixed before any result of this template, from one published rule: LLM-Pruner prunes only a middle span of layers and keeps the first few and the final layer, so the first and last depth quarters get half intensity; attention and MLP are treated alike because the literature disagrees on which is more prunable. Not derived from any of our searches.
